column1: # p387 — 2026-10-22 — package-registry recency applied to the LMS/MCP and agent shelves.
# Method: read the package NAME from the manifest at the repo's real default ref, then query the registry.
#   npm:  registry.npmjs.org/<name>   -> dist-tags.latest, time.created, time.<latest>, versions.<latest>.license, .repository
#   pypi: pypi.org/pypi/<name>/json   -> info.version, info.license(_expression), min/max releases[].upload_time
# Why: github.com and api.github.com are 403, so stars and commit dates are unreadable. A publish date is
# a better procurement signal than a star count anyway: it dates the artefact a studio would actually install.
# CAUTION (this pass's own instrument error, caught): a manifest name is NOT proof of a publication.
#   faizan45640/google-classroom-mcp-server declares name "class" -> npm "class" is an unrelated 2013 package.
#   Attribute a registry row only when its .repository (or description links) point back at the same slug.
